ChatContext.description:
Sent by the client alongside a chat message. All fields optional --
an empty/omitted context reproduces the pre-STO-596 behavior exactly
(build_chat_system_prompt returns None).
ChatContext.title: ChatContext

EdgeTransform.description:
Declarative edge transform (P0 graph foundation, Slice A). Schema
only — no application logic exists yet; that lands with Slice B's
contract validation pass.
EdgeTransform.title: EdgeTransform

GraphGroup.description:
Large-graph complexity, Wave 7b (STO-611): a visual frame around a
set of nodes. Display-only -- never part of the semantic fingerprint,
never read by the compiler's execution path or the runtime.
GraphGroup.title: GraphGroup

GraphLayer.description:
Large-graph complexity, Wave 7d (STO-622): an architecture layer
(Ingress, Reasoning, ...). Display-only, like groups: nodes join one via
`extensions.layer`, which fingerprint.py treats as a display key.
GraphLayer.title: GraphLayer

GraphSummary.description:
A saved graph without its nodes/edges (GET /api/graph-summaries):
enough for lists, pickers and `/run` parsing. Served from the graph
catalog -- one object read, not one per graph.
GraphSummary.title: GraphSummary

PolicyRuleSetting.description: One scope's setting for one rule. `None` / missing params inherit.
PolicyRuleSetting.title: PolicyRuleSetting

PolicySettings.description: A scope's (workspace or one graph's) rule settings, keyed by code.
PolicySettings.title: PolicySettings

PortKind.description: Built-in port contract vocabulary (P0 graph foundation, Slice A).
PortKind.title: PortKind

ResourceUsage.description:
One node that references a registry resource (Wave 4a "used by",
backend/app/bindings.py `resource_usages`). `via` is set for indirect
use -- an MCP server reached through a bound tool (`"tools:<id>"`).
ResourceUsage.title: ResourceUsage

RunResumeRequest.description:
Body for POST /api/runs/{id}/resume (studio-consolidation Phase 2,
human_gate). approve=False rejects the checkpoint and fails the run
without resuming execution.
RunResumeRequest.title: RunResumeRequest

UpdatePolicyExceptionRequest.description: Extend (or shorten) a waiver, optionally re-stating why.
UpdatePolicyExceptionRequest.title: UpdatePolicyExceptionRequest

get.description:
SSE stream of a run's events. SDK 2/7 (STO-615): every event carries
`id: <sequence>`, and a reconnect with `Last-Event-ID` (or `?after=`)
resumes after it. With no live bus on this isolate, a finished run's
persisted events are replayed and the stream closes.

schema.title: Response Get Run Node Traces Api Runs  Run Id  Nodes Get

post.description:
P1 rollout plan, Slice C ("Historical replay") — re-executes
`run_id`'s exact original graph read-only, with every non-routing
node's original output frozen. No live tool/LLM calls. An optional
`ReplayRequest` body makes it a counterfactual replay (STO-609).

Resolves a `human_gate` checkpoint (studio-consolidation Phase 2).

approve=True (default) continues execution from the paused node;
approve=False fails the run instead. 404 when there is nothing paused
for this run_id (already resolved, unknown run, or — same accepted
simplification as compiled-workflow lookup elsewhere in this API — the
compiled workflow was lost to a process restart).

get.description:
P0 graph foundation, Slice D: the run's durable RunGraphSnapshot —
the exact graph (and, for a draft-sourced run, resolved resource
bindings) it started from, independent of any later draft edits.
Historical run inspection opens this, not the current (possibly
changed) `GET /api/graphs/{id}`.
